dataset_name: Hargreaves Lithium Solid Electrolyte Conductivity Database ("Liverpool Ionics Dataset")
version: as published on pcwww.liv.ac.uk/~msd30/lmds/LiIonDatabase.html, page states last content update 2024-10-18 ("Entry 703 has been changed from Li6NiBr3 in the original database to Li6NBr3 and the conductivity and reference corrected"); retrieved 2026-09-21
role: npj cross-dataset extension: independent external experimental-conductivity cohort (analogous to DATA_CONTRACT.md role D, but used ONLY as a held-out external transfer target per the npj protocol N2-N6; never merged into OBELiX training data)
paper_reference: Hargreaves, C. J., Gaultois, M. W., Daniels, L. M., Watts, E. J., Kurlin, V. A., Moran, M., Dang, Y., Morris, R., Morscher, A., Thompson, K., Wright, M. A., Prasad, B.-E., Blanc, F., Collins, C. M., Crawford, C. A., Duff, B. B., Evans, J., Gamon, J., Han, G., Leube, B. T., Niu, H., Perez, A. J., Robinson, A., Rogan, O., Sharp, P. M., Shoko, E., Sonni, M., Thomas, W. J., Vasylenko, A., Wang, L., Rosseinsky, M. J. & Dyer, M. S. "A database of experimentally measured lithium solid electrolyte conductivities evaluated with machine learning." npj Computational Materials 9, 9 (2023).
source_repository_code: https://github.com/lrcfmd/LiIonML (notebooks/code only; repo's data/ directory does NOT contain the raw CSV -- README explicitly directs users to download the CSV from the Liverpool page below; repo has no LICENSE file, GitHub API license field is null)
retrieval_method: curl -sk (TLS cert-chain verification failed for pcwww.liv.ac.uk from this environment -- server presented an incomplete chain; -k used for a read-only GET of a public, non-authenticated static file, no credentials involved). HTTP 200, Content-Type text/csv, Content-Length 76402 matched downloaded file size exactly.
license: NOT a standard open license (no CC-BY/MIT/etc. declared). Verbatim from the landing page: "Where a user wishes to use this Database for the purposes of any extraction or re-utilisation for commercial use, then such use may only be granted under licence by the University. To request such consent and the licence terms under which such consent is granted, please contact impactscience@liverpool.ac.uk and ipadmin@liverpool.ac.uk. Any use of the Database, whether for the purpose of illustration for teaching or academic research or under a commercial licence, should include an appropriate citation to acknowledge the source of the Database as the University of Liverpool." Interpretation: academic/research use (this project) is permitted with citation; commercial re-use requires a separate license. Treat as 'research-use-with-attribution, commercial re-use restricted' -- NOT redistribute-freely open data. Manuscript/publication use must cite the University of Liverpool and the Hargreaves et al. paper (DOI 10.1038/s41524-022-00951-z).

files.notes: First 4 lines are a license/citation preamble (not CSV header); real header row 'ID,composition,source,temperature,target,log_target,family,ChemicalFamily' is on line 5 (skiprows=4 when reading with pandas).

reported_count_per_paper: 820 entries from 214 sources (abstract, verified in this project's earlier manuscript reference-verification pass, manuscript/submission/references_verified.md); this manifest's locally verified row count (820) and unique-source count (214) MATCH the publisher abstract exactly.
exclusions: None applied in this audit pass (N1 is audit-only, no filtering/harmonization performed). Row-count and target/log_target consistency checked; no rows dropped.
parser_version: n/a -- audit only, no parser/harmonization script built in N1 (that is N2 scope)
record_unit: one (composition, source-publication, measurement-temperature) ionic-conductivity measurement; NOT one material -- 57.2% of rows share a composition string with >=1 other row (repeat/duplicate-source measurements at different temperatures or from different papers)
target_field: target (float64, S/cm, linear scale) and log_target (float64, precomputed log10(target)); recomputing log10(target) independently and comparing to log_target gives max abs difference 0.00166 across all 820 rows (i.e. log_target is exactly log10(target) to rounding) -- VERIFIED
target_field_unit_note: Linear conductivity is in S/cm (paper-stated unit, matches OBELiX's 'Ionic conductivity (S cm-1)' column -- no unit-harmonization needed for the canonical y = log10(sigma_RT / S cm^-1) target). No pre-baked log10(sigma_RT) exists per se -- log_target is log10 of conductivity AT THE REPORTED MEASUREMENT TEMPERATURE, not necessarily RT; RT filtering must be applied explicitly before computing the npj-protocol target (see temperature_scope below).
temperature_scope: MIXED -- NOT room-temperature only. temperature column (float, degrees C) ranges 5.0 to 873.0 (mean 93.3, median 30.0). Only 465/820 rows (56.7%) fall in a [15,35] C 'near-room-temperature' window; 355/820 rows (43.3%) are at other temperatures (many are clearly elevated-T conductivity measurements, e.g. Arrhenius-series entries at 100/150/200/300 C). 325/820 rows (39.6%) are recorded at exactly 25.0 C.

temperature_scope_verification.method: Direct inspection of the 'temperature' column across all 820 rows (pandas .describe(), .value_counts(), and an explicit [15,35] C filter).
temperature_scope_verification.paper_cross_check: Paper abstract (per prior verification pass and search-result excerpts) states '403 unique chemical compositions with an associated ionic conductivity near room temperature (15-35 C)'. This audit's [15,35] C window independently found 465 rows / 422 unique compositions -- close to but NOT an exact match to the paper's 403 (unique-composition count differs by 19; possible causes: a different/narrower RT window used by the paper's authors, or an unstated composition-normalization/near-duplicate-merging rule before their count -- NOT VERIFIED, do not assume 422 or 403 is 'correct' without re-deriving the paper's exact RT-window and composition-normalization rule).
temperature_scope_verification.verification_status: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED -- RT-mixed-temperature scope of the raw file is directly confirmed; the paper's exact 403-composition RT count is NOT independently reproduced from the raw CSV and must not be treated as authoritative for N2 cohort construction without re-deriving the exact rule.

censoring.method: All 820 'target'/'log_target' values parsed as clean float64 with pandas (no coercion errors); raw file text contains zero '<' or '>' characters anywhere, confirming no inequality-censored entries exist in this dataset (unlike OBELiX, which has 37/599 inequality-censored rows).
censoring.verification_status: VERIFIED -- this dataset has NO censored/thresholded values; DATA_CONTRACT.md's censoring policy is not triggered for this source.

duplicates.duplicated_ID_rows: 1 collision: ID 922 appears twice, once as composition 'Li0.022 La0.118 Ti0.2 Al0.004 O0.631' (Perovskite) and once as 'LiF' (Rocksalt) -- a genuine upstream ID-assignment bug in the source file, NOT a project-side parsing error. Flagged, not corrected (raw data is immutable per DATA_CONTRACT.md); any downstream use must key on row index / a project-assigned surrogate key, not the source 'ID' column, or must explicitly resolve this collision first.
duplicates.duplicate_compositions: 469/820 rows (57.2%) share a composition string with >=1 other row; 489 unique compositions total. These are predominantly repeat measurements (different source DOI and/or different temperature for the same nominal composition), not row-level duplication.
duplicates.duplicate_composition_source_pairs: 420/820 rows share both composition AND source DOI with >=1 other row (i.e. the same paper reports the same composition more than once, almost always at different temperatures, e.g. an Arrhenius series).
duplicates.duplicate_composition_source_temperature: 4 rows form 2 pairs where composition+source+temperature are all identical but the reported target value differs slightly (IDs 613/614: Li0.34La0.56TiO3 from the same source at the same nominal temperature with two distinct conductivity values; IDs 158/160: Li1.4S2.2P0.6, same pattern). Likely two measurements/samples reported in the same paper at nominally the same temperature. Zero rows are FULLY identical (composition+source+temperature+target) -- there is no true exact-duplicate row in this dataset.
duplicates.verification_status: VERIFIED by direct pandas duplicated()/value_counts() inspection of all 820 rows.

source_paper_ids: Column 'source' holds a DOI string for the originating publication of each measurement (99.5% of values match the regex ^10\. ; the remaining ~0.5% were not individually inspected in this pass). 214 unique DOIs across 820 rows, exactly matching the paper's stated '214 sources'. This is directly usable for N2's cross-dataset bibliographic-overlap check against OBELiX's per-row DOI column.

family_chemical_family_labels.structural_family_column: 'family' -- populated for all 820 rows (0 missing). 15+ distinct values (top 5: NASICON 217, Perovskite 119, Garnet 119, Glass 102, Thio-LISICON 62). Directly usable as a chemistry/structure-family axis for LOMFO/Family-GroupKFold per EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md-style splits.
family_chemical_family_labels.chemical_family_column: 'ChemicalFamily' -- 321/820 rows (39.1%) missing (NaN). Populated values: Oxides 362, Sulphides 70, Sulphides and Other Anions 34, Oxides and Other Anions 19, Other 7, Halides 7. Coarser and less complete than 'family'; treat missing values as an explicit '__MISSING__' category per the npj protocol's N9 sensitivity-analysis instruction, do not silently impute.

structure_availability: Composition-only. No CIF, space group, lattice parameter, or ICSD/structure-ID column exists anywhere in this file or in the linked GitHub repo's data/ directory. This matches N3's requirement that the primary portable benchmark use composition-only descriptors -- no structure-availability mismatch between this dataset and OBELiX needs to be engineered around for the N3 model ladder.
notes: Raw file's first 4 lines are a license/citation preamble embedded directly in the CSV (not typical machine-readable CSV hygiene) -- any loader must skip these 4 lines (skiprows=4) before the real header. Preliminary informational-only composition-string overlap against OBELiX (data/raw/obelix/all.csv 'Reduced Composition' + 'True Composition' columns, whitespace-stripped string match, NOT a fingerprint/StructureMatcher audit): 197/478 (41.2%) of Hargreaves' unique normalized composition strings also appear as an OBELiX composition string. This is a raw upper-bound signal only -- it is NOT the DATA_CONTRACT.md-required canonical-identity/overlap audit (that requires reduced composition + anonymized formula + space group + structure fingerprint + source IDs per DATA_CONTRACT.md 'Canonical identity and overlap audit', and is explicitly N2 scope, not built here). Flagged prominently because it is large enough to materially threaten N2's >=100-independent-row strict-cohort gate if a large fraction of true duplicates/overlaps get excluded.
